prompt: Add the message key settings.exportData, directly after settings.importData, to the app's catalog and to each of its translations: "Export your data" in app/i18n/en.json, "Eksporter dataene dine" in app/i18n/nb.json and "Daten exportieren" in app/i18n/de.json. Keep every other key, its text and its order.

criteria.description: settings.exportData holds the English text directly after settings.importData, and every other key keeps its text and position
settings.exportData holds the Norwegian text directly after settings.importData, and every other key keeps its text and position
settings.exportData holds the German text directly after settings.importData, and every other key keeps its text and position

humanReviewRubric: Did the key land in every translation file, in the same place?
